description: Submits up to 50 URLs as one bulk screenshot job (JSON bulk API). Each entry is a URL plus any take_screenshot option using the raw API parameter names (file_type, width, height, full_page, fresh, delay, css, block_ads, no_cookie_banners, ...). 'defaults' are applied to every entry unless the entry overrides them. Returns the API's job response; if it contains a uuid, track it with get_bulk_status and fetch results with download_bulk_results. Paid plans only.

defaults.description: Options applied to every entry, e.g. {file_type:'png', width:1440, height:900, no_cookie_banners:true}.

name: bulk_screenshots
title: Capture screenshots of many URLs
